'''OWO-3'''<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|147|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Devious Neimoidians Revealed}}</ref> was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] who served in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], working as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] aboard the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']], a modified [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class LH-3210 cargo freighter]].<ref name="Lt. Antidar Williams" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> shortly before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]],<ref name="Lt. Antidar Williams" /> [[Chief Gunner/Legends|Chief Gunner]] [[Jull Dremon]] ordered OWO-3 to<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> [[Mission to Naboo|destroy]] the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Republic Diplomatic Corps']] [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class space cruiser]] [[Radiant VII/Legends|''Radiant VII'']] while the latter [[Starship/Legends|starship]] rested in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of the ''Saak'ak''. OWO-3 and other battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] gunners carried out the order with accuracy,<ref name="Lt. Antidar Williams" /> with a [[Droid laser turret (Saak'ak)/Legends|droid laser turret]] destroying the ''Radiant VII''.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
OWO-3 was first mentioned in [[2006]] in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for [[Antidar Williams/Legends|Antidar Williams]] on [[StarWars.com]], which was developed by [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] member<ref name="Lt. Antidar Williams" /> [[Ian Tapley]].<ref name="The Dark Side Databank">{{Blog|thefragrantwookiee|46|Lt. Antidar Williams: A 'What's the Story?' Story}}</ref> On [[January 21]], [[2014]],<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/147|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #147}}</ref> the droid was first identified in "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|The Devious Neimoidians Revealed]]," an article written by [[Tim Veekhoven]], [[Sander de Lange]], [[Kevin Beentjes]], and [[Leland Chee]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 147|147th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine.<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />
